text:
sophie: quick follow-up from the PM: we need owners + short deadlines for rollout/canary hardening after the incident. compact thread.
jamal: agree. let's do HOT (1w), NEAR (3w), ROADMAP.
anya: HOT -> emergency opt-out flag + runtime fallback to safe-model group. i'll own. ETA 2026-03-29.
mike: HOT -> auto-rollback controller + canary harness. conditions: error_rate >=1.5% over 3m OR p95 >1.8s over 2m. i'll PR by 2026-04-01.
sophie: add blast-radius caps: default 5% traffic for 15m, scope by region+customer-tier. jamal can you own console UX?
jamal: yep. modal + API + audit events. ETA 2026-04-06.
anya: include KV warmup gate for large-KV models: require prefix-cache-hit >=70% before ramp.
mike: will add KV gate check to controller and a manual override that needs SRE signoff.
oncall-bot: Reminder created: "Rollout safety sync" weekly Mon 10:00 starting 2026-03-30. Attendees: eng-sre, eng-runtime.
sophie: tracker created: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/rollout-safety (cols: owner, ETA, status, blockers). i'll update postmortem with these items.
jamal: add runbook steps for manual rollback and emergency flag flip; make visible to oncall by default.
sophie: action summary: 1) opt-out flag -> anya -> 2026-03-29; 2) auto-rollback & tests -> mike -> 2026-04-01; 3) console caps -> jamal -> 2026-04-06; 4) KV gate & telemetry -> anya+mike -> 2026-04-01. reply if missing. :white_check_mark:
